Title: What is a Continental Championship Qualifier?

Messages.Author: MarcusVitel
Messages.Body:
I know Ankha and I had this discussion before by email, but now that I have recovered a bit from being very agitated about it I would like to get a better understanding of the qualifier process for a continental championship.

Question: What is the definition of a Continental Championship Qualifier? Where in the (tournament) rules is this specified?

Thanks

MV

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Qualifiers are mentioned in two places :  The  Tournament Rules article under Rules in the left menu, section 9.8. "Non-Open V:TES Events" The  Continental Championships article under Events in the left menu
Also, "Continental Qualifier" is an event type when creating a new event.

To sum up:
Continental qualifiers allow players to attend a non-open continental championship.
The same way, national qualifiers allow players to attend a non-open national championship.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Author: MarcusVitel

> MarcusVitel wrote:
> Absolutely right, so why would you ever hold a tournament that is not a Qualifier?
>
Because each country has a limited number of Qualifier events. The National Coordinators decide how many qualifiers will be held in each country (usually 1 or 2).

> Exposer wrote:
> Qualification for 1GW in Continental Qualifier is a pleasant difference.
> But what is the difference between usual Constructed and National Qualifier?
>
A National Qualifier qualifies players with 1 GW for the National Championship of the same country.
A constructed tournament qualifies only the winning player.

(Since a National Qualifier is a tournament, it qualifies also the winner for any Continental Championship).

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> MarcusVitel wrote:
> Coming back to the subject of this thread: A Qualifier is also an event organized by the NC of a region/ country,
>
It doesn't have to be organized by the NC. Any player can organize tournaments.

> MarcusVitel wrote:
> that could be run by a Prince if delegated by the NC.
>
A prince or anyone.

How does it work: the organizer of the future event asks the NC if his or her tournament can be a qualifier, or alternatively, the NC contacts the Prince of a city in which he or she would like a qualifier to take place.

> MarcusVitel wrote:
> As far as I know there is nothing in the rules about the number of qualifiers that can be held. So it could easily be any number as long as the NC agrees.
>
There's a consensus not to organize more than 1 or 2 Continental Qualifiers per country. Allowing more would remove any interest into organizing such events. People travel through countries to attend Qualifiers. If every tournament was a qualifier, people would stop doing so.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director
